dataset_story: The RoEduNet-SIMARGL2021 dataset captures network intrusion attempts across a realistic academic network. It is used in AURA to detect environment-level threats.
aura_purpose: Detects malicious network environments, such as TOR exit nodes or VPN-based masking.

citation.text: Mihailescu, M. E., et al. (2021). The Proposition and Evaluation of the RoEduNet-SIMARGL2021 Network Intrusion Detection Dataset. Sensors.
